Tutorial_Subtitle: Follow the guide to master core features in 2 minutes
Tutorial_WelcomeDesc: This interactive tutorial will guide you step-by-step to master the core high-efficiency features of SwiftList. Click the button below to start!
Tutorial_Step1_Desc: Double-tap the **Ctrl** key rapidly in any environment to wake up the search window. Type 'sl_logo' to view matched highlights, then press **Ctrl+1** or **double-click/click** to open the first result.
Tutorial_Step1_Todo1: Double-tap Ctrl key to show search panel
Tutorial_Step1_Todo3: Press Ctrl+1 or double-click/click to open
Tutorial_Step2_Desc: Press **Ctrl+C** on any search result to copy the actual file/folder entity directly to the clipboard and automatically close the search panel. Press **Right Arrow (→)** or **Right-click** to open the Actions Menu.
Tutorial_Step2_Todo1: Wake up search panel and type 'sl_demo'
Tutorial_Step2_Todo2: Select result, press Ctrl+C to copy entity and auto-close
Tutorial_Step2_Todo3: Wake up again and press Right Arrow (→) or Right-click to open Actions Menu
Tutorial_Step3_Desc: Type math formulas (e.g. `50+50`), environment variables (e.g. `%temp%`), or web search commands (e.g. `gg SwiftList`, `bd Baidu`) to get instant evaluations or open searches directly in your default browser.
Tutorial_Step3_Todo1: Type math expression like `50 + 50` to view results
Tutorial_Step3_Todo3: Type `gg SwiftList` and press Enter to search in browser
Tutorial_Step4_Desc: Open any Windows Explorer window. SwiftList will automatically dock an Inline Search Bar at the bottom. Type folder keywords and hit Enter to instantly jump Explorer to that folder.
Tutorial_Step4_Todo2: Observe the docked inline bar at the bottom and type keywords
Tutorial_Step4_Todo3: Press Enter to experience instant directory navigation
Tutorial_Step5_Desc: When you open an 'Open/Save' dialog in any application, you don't need to navigate manually. Simply activate a Windows Explorer window, switch back to the file dialog, and press **Ctrl+G** to instantly redirect the dialog to that directory!
Tutorial_Step5_Todo1: Open any file dialog (e.g., File -> Open in Notepad)
Tutorial_Step5_Todo2: Press Ctrl+G while the file dialog is focused
Tutorial_NotCompletedWarn: Please complete all tasks in the current level first!
Tutorial_CongratsDesc: You have completed all tutorial levels. You are now a SwiftList efficiency expert. Go ahead and start your high-efficiency journey!
